title: Find another recoverable terminal-phase plateau
hypothesis: At least one unscanned task has a terminal-geometry bottleneck that expert takeover can complete from learner states but fixed-budget parameter search cannot.

prediction.against: Task-matched scripted expert on the same 30 confirmation cases
prediction.rationale: At least one task must exhibit a learner–expert gap of 0.90 or more, with zero learner successes, to justify another trace-repair testbed rather than merely another difficult task.

falsified_by: Every expert-qualified task produces a learner success during search or confirmation, or every confirmed zero-success learner has fewer than three successful expert takeovers out of five. If no expert qualifies, the plateau question is inconclusive; the missing measurement is a reliable expert's success on those tasks.

approval.note: approved by advisor gpt-6.1-sol (consult call_00060, 'revise' with changes applied) under the user's 2026-10-22 session delegation

metrics.note_on_metric: no task reached confirmation; every task's search already succeeded on the probe

controls.note: control is each task's scripted expert on its 30 confirmation cases (all >= 0.90)

result.notes: Sequential scan in frozen order (shelf-place, basketball, soccer). Experts: 1.00, 1.00, 0.90 (all qualified). One gpt-6.1-sol single-phase structure per task (all valid first time) with 24-candidate search on 5 probe cases: 22, 20 and 23 of 24 candidates succeeded, so none is a plateau and no confirmation or takeover stage ran. Refuted by the predeclared rule (every expert-qualified task produced a learner success in search). Across D-019, D-016..D-018, D-029 and this scan, assembly-v2 is the only MetaWorld task found where single-phase generation plus search plateaus. 450 episodes, 3 LLM calls.

verdicts.reasoning: All three experts qualified (1.00, 1.00, 0.90), and every task's single-phase structure plus 24-candidate search already succeeded on the probe (22, 20 and 23 of 24 candidates), which is the predeclared refutation condition. No second plateau exists among the scanned tasks; assembly-v2 remains the only one.
verdicts.next_experiment: The recipe solves every single-object MetaWorld task scanned except assembly; trace-guided editing fixes assembly. Next: integrate trace-guided repair into the pipeline (R-036) so assembly is solved end to end, and consider a multi-task MT10/MT50 benchmark run as the final evaluation.

verdicts.reasoning: The task-matched expert controls were measured and qualified: shelf-place and basketball scored 1.00, and soccer scored 0.90 [logs/research/recoverable_plateau_scan/summary.json]. Their searches produced 22, 20, and 23 successful probe candidates, respectively, satisfying the predeclared falsification condition that every expert-qualified task produces a learner success during search [logs/research/recoverable_plateau_scan/summary.json]. No learner confirmation or takeover episodes ran, so the reported promotion_success_rate of 1.0 does not establish a confirmation-set learner–expert gap; the refutation rests on the search stopping rule [logs/research/recoverable_plateau_scan/summary.json]. Actual expenditure was 450 simulator episodes and 3 LLM calls [logs/research/recoverable_plateau_scan/summary.json].
